name: Giant-forget-me-not
desc: Giant-forget-me-not (Andersonglossum virginianum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 52 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Andersonglossum virginianum, known as southern wild comfrey, is a flowering plant in the borage family native to North America. It is also sometimes called blue houndstongue.
